value.name: Micky walks away silently
value.description: Micky walks off in silence, showing a subdued emotional state as the camera follows him into the distance.
evidence: Micky walks -- silently -- camera tracks with him, on his face. Then let's him go into distance.

value.name: Training resumes at Ramalho's gym
value.description: Days later, Micky is shown back in training, jumping rope, doing abs, hitting the speed bag, and moving in the ring under Mickey O'Keefe's supervision.
evidence: OMITTED RAMALHO'S WEST END GYM - DAYS
Days later: MICKY JUMPS ROPE; MICKY DOES ABS WORK under Mickey O'Keefe's watchful gaze.; MICKY HITS SPEED BAG; MICKY MOVES IN RING. JUMPS ROPE AGAIN.

value.name: Charlene and others are revealed at the gym
value.description: The scene reveals Charlene, George, and Sal LoNano watching Micky train.
evidence: Pan reveals: Charlene, George, and SAL LONANO, 45, Italian, dark, mustache, tinted glasses, thick dark hair, watch.

value.name: Micky greets Charlene
value.description: Micky stops training, catches his breath, and kisses Charlene hello.
evidence: Micky stops jumping, catching his breath. Kisses Charlene hello.

value.name: Mickey O'Keefe praises Micky's persistence
value.description: Mickey O'Keefe tells the group that Micky keeps trying, is protected by fate, and fights in a way that defines him.
evidence: MICKEY O'KEEFE Nobody keeps tryin' like this kid, I swear to God someone up there's watchin' over him, he's far from done. He'll take five punches to land one, that's how he fights, that's who he is.

value.name: Sal LoNano introduces himself
value.description: Mickey O'Keefe introduces Sal LoNano to Micky, and Micky responds with a business-minded question.
evidence: MICKY You own a cab company, you're a good businessman, right?

value.name: Sal offers a local comeback fight
value.description: Sal says he has already made calls and can get Micky a small local fight to help him restart and rebuild confidence.
evidence: SAL LONANO (NODS) I already made some calls. Spoke to Bobby Tags and he says we can get a small fight, somethin' local to staht back with.
MICKEY O'KEEFE Get ya confidence back. SAL LONANO Right, go from there.

value.name: Mickey O'Keefe sets conditions for training
value.description: Mickey O'Keefe agrees to train Micky only if Dicky and Alice stay away, making clear he will quit if they return.
evidence: MICKEY O'KEEFE - Micky, I know ya dad wants this guy to manage ya, and I'll train ya on one condition.
MICKEY O'KEEFE No Dicky, no Alice. If they come back, I'm gone, Mick. I can't deal with the bullshit, no offense Georgie.

value.name: Charlene warns against chaos
value.description: Charlene backs the condition by insisting there be no more crazy behavior.

value.name: George jokes about losing his balls
value.description: George responds to the no-Dicky-no-Alice condition with a dark joke about being punished if they return.
evidence: GEORGE None taken, I'm the one who's gonna get his balls cut off anyway.
